report:
A, B, and C all agreed to the next step. They will pause use of the leaking espresso machine until facilities says it is safe. B will send facilities one brief request for a 15-minute safety and fact-finding check. The request will state that no work, spending, disposal, or ownership decision is authorized.

I sent the current list to A, B, and C in the same wording, at the end of my last message to each of them. No one reported a correction, so the list did not change. The office still needs to name the owner of the machine and grinder, and the person who can approve work and spending. After the check, they can compare a safe repaired machine with a simpler replacement and keep the grinder if it works with the chosen machine. This keeps B's repair option and A's low-upkeep option open, and gives C safe, working coffee. I cannot decide ownership, approve purchases, make legal decisions, or move money.
